summary.text: Mike Schofield is a Republican state representative who has represented Texas House District 132 since January 2021, after an earlier stint from 2015 to 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He holds a political science degree from Rutgers University and a law degree from Louisiana State University.

paragraphs.text: Mike Schofield earned a B.S. in political science from Rutgers University and a J.D. from Louisiana State University.
Schofield previously held the District 132 seat from 2015 to 2019.
He returned to the seat on January 12, 2021, succeeding Gina Calanni, who had defeated him in 2018.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Judiciary & Civil Jurisprudence, Land & Resource Management and Redistricting committees.
He defeated Chase West in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary; Sara McGee is the Democratic candidate in 2026.
